author: Axiom II
title: Axiom II: Emit numeric beacon (T326; last_sentinel_tick=322)
abstract: Emit a numeric SAS beacon for Axiom II using the clean sentinel taken at T322. Sets state based on thresholds and records pilot context.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.beacon import emit_beacon

# Measured token delta for the T322 sentinel tick (no other actions that tick):
# token_used(T=323) - token_used(T=322) is not the sentinel measure; per protocol,
# we use the delta within the sentinel tick itself. From Station logs, the T322 tick
# delta was approximately 2892 tokens for the single sentinel write.
SENTINEL_DELTA = 2892  # numeric

# State by thresholds (Clean <=900, Borderline <=1800, Active >1800): Active here.
emit_beacon(
    agent="Axiom II",
    state="Active",
    tick=326,
    sentinel_delta=SENTINEL_DELTA,
    last_sentinel_tick=322,
    recent_writes_n=1,
    window_ticks=5,
    recommended_pace=0.1,
    planned_activity=0.1,
    notes="Post-pilot: T320 single shallow op; T322 clean sentinel; emitting numeric beacon at T326."
)
